_comment: The one WEB_SOCKET_MESSAGE_REQUESTED wire shape, shared by the three packages that make up the realtime push path so none of them can drift alone. The syncing-server produces the payload, the home-server bridge publishes JSON.stringify(payload) on `channel`, and the websocket-gateway consumes it from that channel and delivers `payload.message` to `payload.userUuid`, skipping `payload.originatingSessionUuid`. Asserted by SendEventToClient.spec.ts, WebSocketRedisBridge.spec.ts and redisBridge.test.ts.
